question: How do healthy and same-probe source-worker-failure workflow completion times vary with system DP and context length under same-node versus cross-node protection paths?
selection_policy: All registered cells and all three seeds are retained regardless of direction, significance, or whether AegisKV improves WCT.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA A100 40GB modeled as 40 GiB addressable HBM
hardware.placement: one TP1/PP1 replica per GPU; contiguous ranks in complete 8-GPU nodes

same_node.peer_rule: bijective successor GPU within each 8-GPU node
same_node.dram_rule: CPU DRAM attached to the source node

cross_node.peer_rule: bijective GPU target on the next node in a node ring
cross_node.dram_rule: CPU DRAM attached to the next node in the same ring

capacity_equation.no_oracle: dispatch must not inspect realized output length or realized service time
capacity_equation.analytic_gate: two max-context reservations fit the frozen serving-plus-backup budget before dynamic backup reclaim

workload.probe_schedule: equal-width stratified timestamps over the common 90 s arrival window; paired source rank and timestamp across policies and topologies
workload.primary_denominator: all workflows from the same workflow universe for healthy and every same-probe failure replay
workload.warmup: none; cold-start-inclusive 90 s pilot retained by preregistration

statistics.interval: Student-t 95% confidence interval across seed-level means (df=2)
primary: healthy all-workflow mean and p99 WCT
same-probe source-worker-failure all-workflow mean and p99 WCT
paired AegisKV-minus-Native mean WCT and ratio
workflow throughput, queue wait, capacity blocks, copy bytes, reclaim bytes, recovery actions

figure_grammar.layout: 2x2; columns are scale and context axes; rows are healthy and same-probe failure-conditioned mean WCT
figure_grammar.x_scale: categorical registered values in ascending order
figure_grammar.panel_text_boundary: no seed, hash, preliminary, or evidence prose inside panels; evidence boundary remains in manifest/caption JSON

hard_gates: exactly 108 registered cells are atomically published
workflow universe and fault probe tuple hashes match across Native Mooncake and AegisKV and across both topology treatments for each axis point and seed
source_worker_gpu failure invalidates exactly one source rank
same-node and cross-node route tables are bijective and use their registered directional bandwidths
every recorded physical target satisfies the frozen 40 GiB capacity equation
scheduled and controller-admitted HBM and DRAM copy bytes conserve exactly
future or unsealed backup never participates in source dispatch
empty fault replay exactly reproduces the coupled healthy schedule
fault replay never lowers any workflow WCT
no seed or cell is selected by result shape
figure is a single-page vector PDF with PNG width at least 1800 px and extracted minimum font size at least 7 pt
evidence_boundary: Three-seed cold-start-inclusive metadata DES pilot. A100 capacity and local model bytes are frozen, but service coefficients, directional bandwidth, 500 ms fence activation, and 60 s Native replacement are modeled/unmeasured. Native Mooncake is a modeled Router+Store approximation. This is not physical A100 or paper-ready evidence.
